content_descriptors.notes:
This game is a mystery visual novel featuring a dark, mature theme. The main plot revolves around a murder investigation and includes descriptions of a crime scene. The game contains visual depictions of blood, particularly on the "game over" screen that appears when the player fails a case.
Additionally, the narrative explores mature themes such as alcohol consumption, substance abuse (pills/medication), gambling debt, and threats. Due to these elements, this game is intended for a mature audience.
